cameraForm.sourceTypeWebpage: Web page (renders a URL as a camera)
cameraForm.onvifUrlLabel: ONVIF service URL (optional — fills the fields below)
cameraForm.onvifUrlPasswordHint: Clicking "Get video URLs" without typing a password reuses this camera's already-saved password. Fill it in here (user:password@...) or in the "Password" field below only if you want to use a different one.
cameraForm.webpageWarning: Renders the page with a headless browser (Chromium) and captures it as video (~2 fps) — by far the heaviest source on CPU/RAM in the app. Only use it when you really need to (e.g. mirroring a dashboard or a public camera without RTSP).
cameraForm.mjpegHint: For old webcams/cameras that only speak MJPEG over HTTP (no RTSP). Credentials can go directly in the URL (username:password@host).
cameraForm.rtspHint: DVR/NVR cameras: each channel usually has its own URL (e.g. .../cam/realmonitor?channel=1&subtype=0). Credentials can go in the URL itself, or in the fields below (safer if the password has special characters).
cameraForm.ptzOnvifConnectionHint: ONVIF connection (optional, only for PTZ controls - doesn't affect the video/recording above)
cameraForm.rotationHint: For cameras mounted sideways or upside down. Forces a transcode (ffmpeg re-encodes the video), so it uses more CPU than a plain relay.
cameraForm.recordingModeMotionHint: Recording starts when motion is detected (see "Motion detection" below) and continues for 1 minute after the last event. Needs an active detection source to work.
cameraForm.motionDetectionLabel: Motion detection (independent from the recording mode above)
cameraForm.motionDetectionCheckbox: Detect motion on this camera (alerts: flash/toast/snapshot/notifications)
cameraForm.motionDetectionNeedsSourceHint: Motion recording needs an active detection to know when to record — even with this checkbox unchecked, the source below keeps running just to trigger recording.
cameraForm.detectionSourceVideoHint: Runs on the server, analyzing the video itself (OpenCV) — works even when the camera advertises ONVIF event support but it doesn't actually work (common on cheaper models).
cameraForm.detectionSourceOnvifHint: Uses the camera's own ONVIF event subscription — lighter, but depends on the firmware actually supporting it.
cameraForm.vlcRelayCheckbox: Camera with incompatible RTSP (use VLC relay)
cameraForm.vlcRelayHint: Use when the stream shows "unavailable" even with the camera online. An internal VLC process connects to the camera and re-exposes the video in a format MediaMTX can consume.
cameraForm.ptzHint: Enables the "PTZ" button for this camera in the Grid, with a joystick control to move the camera and manage presets.
cameraForm.onvifConnectionFailed: Could not connect to the camera via ONVIF.
cameraForm.saveFailed: Failed to save the camera. Check the details and try again.
cameraForm.objectDetectionHint: Runs a lightweight YOLO model only when the motion detector (above) already triggered — reduces false positives (shadows, wind, etc). Requires the model files to be configured on the server (see docs/configuration.md).
cameraForm.detectionZoneNeedsSave: Save the camera first to set the zone

detectionZone.title: Zone of interest

onvifScan.title: Network scan (ONVIF/RTSP)
onvifScan.description: Tests every IP in the range for open RTSP/ONVIF ports — works even when automatic discovery (WS-Discovery) finds nothing, which is common when running in Docker.
onvifScan.summaryOnvifPortOpen: ONVIF port {{port}} open (no credentials to confirm)
onvifScan.summaryRtspPortOpen: RTSP port (554) open, but no common URL responded

grid.confirmDeleteGrid: Remove this grid? This doesn't affect the cameras, only the saved layout.
grid.goToCamerasHint: Go to Cameras to discover or add an ONVIF camera.
grid.gridNamePlaceholder: E.g.: Entrance, Backyard, Living room tablet

grid.fitAllHint: Automatically adjusts tile size and column count so every camera fits on screen without scrolling.

settingsPage.title: Settings
settingsPage.description: Adjust the system settings, such as the page's HLS stream optimization settings and notifications automatically sent when a motion/tamper event is detected (ONVIF or video analysis). Each channel independently decides whether to send the moment's snapshot as an attachment.
settingsPage.autoSavedHint: Saved automatically with the value above. Use "Remove" to clear it.
settingsPage.autoSavedHintPlural: Saved automatically with the values above. Use "Remove" to clear them.
settingsPage.webhookHint: Sends a POST with JSON (camera, event type, message, time). Useful for integrating with n8n, Home Assistant, etc.
settingsPage.attachSnapshotBase64: Send snapshot as attachment (base64 in JSON)
settingsPage.s3Description: Optional: sends event snapshots to an S3 bucket (or compatible, e.g. Linode, DigitalOcean Spaces, MinIO) into a camsnapshots/<camera> folder, and uses the public URL when notifying Discord/Telegram/generic webhook — more reliable than a multipart attachment in some cases. Files are automatically deleted following each camera's retention setting.
settingsPage.toastTestFailed: Failed to send the test notification.
settingsPage.toastDiscordRemoveFailed: Failed to remove the Discord webhook.
settingsPage.toastWebhookSaveFailed: Failed to save the generic webhook.
settingsPage.toastWebhookRemoveFailed: Failed to remove the generic webhook.
settingsPage.pushDescription: Get a browser notification on this device when a motion/tamper event happens, even with the app closed (works best when installed as a PWA). Requires HTTPS, or localhost during development.
settingsPage.toastPushEnabled: Push notifications enabled on this device.
settingsPage.toastPushPermissionDenied: Notification permission was denied in the browser.
settingsPage.toastPushDisabled: Push notifications disabled on this device.
settingsPage.captioningDescription: Uses an OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint (e.g. a local Ollama/LM Studio instance) to generate a short caption for notable events, per detected category (item 1's object detection).
settingsPage.captioningApiKeyPlaceholder: API key (optional, leave blank to keep)
settingsPage.toastCaptioningSaveFailed: Failed to save the captioning settings.
settingsPage.streamDescription: Tune how MediaMTX generates HLS and how the browser player buffers it - useful when the camera's stream is already connected but the web player is still slow to start or fails.
settingsPage.streamMuxerCloseAfterLabel: Keep HLS warm after last viewer (e.g. 60s)
settingsPage.streamAlwaysRemuxLabel: Always generate HLS, even with no viewers (uses more RAM, removes first-load delay)
settingsPage.streamPreferSubStreamLabel: Use the lower-quality sub-stream in the grid (switches to main stream in fullscreen)
